description: 🆕 Every other B20 check reads what the issuer CAN do; this reads what they HAVE done. Scans the token's actual burnBlocked seizures (the BurnedBlocked event) — whether the issuer has ever burned a blocked holder's balance, who was seized, and how much. verdict: enforced (has seized) / armed (can, hasn't) / no_seize_power. Pass wallet= for one address, or omit address= for the network-wide feed.
name: b20_seizure_history

checkedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the underlying reads were taken.

data.description: The result payload. Shape is service-specific; every field is documented in the tool description.
